What Ollie Says at 3 A.M., Part 1: the dialogue track

All 40 lines at their real times in the 120-second film, voices only (no music or effects). Built-in ElevenLabs voices; the toddler voice (Jessica +7 semitones) and Ollie (Lily +8 semitones) are pitched up. Every Polish line was transcribed back by speech-to-text and matched word for word.
